hypotheses.statement: PLAN D4 decision-stage bound: the NAME acceptance association (G_dec, 2024-26) is not identified by the current audit, because its tipping point (pilot ~1.8 pp) lies inside the audit 95% CI of the net-flip DiD (pilot +2.1 pp, se 2.4).
hypotheses.estimate: net-flip DiD 2.09 pp, 95% CI [-3.16, 7.33] (pseudo-flip Wald; plain Wald se 2.37 pp, bootstrap [-2.57, 6.94]); tipping point D*_dec 2.92 pp; observed G_dec 1.050 [1.027, 1.073]; audit-implied submission-stage G_dec [0.917, 1.101]; n = 206 accepted / 125 rejected pairs (v1-present 52/42)
hypotheses.notes: Tipping point regenerated at 2.9 pp (pilot 1.8 pp); the conclusion (not identified) is unchanged under plain Wald, bootstrap, 2024-26-only, IPW and union-route audits (T4_2_identification_by_spec.csv).

hypotheses.statement: Gate (PLAN section 4): at least one title feature's acceptance association (G_dec != 1, 2024-26) survives the camera-ready audit (auditable, tipping point beyond the audit CI, observed G_dec CI excludes 1).
hypotheses.estimate: 0 of 24 title features pass (10 auditable); identified under any spec: none
hypotheses.notes: Acceptance-margin claims about title features therefore cannot enter the headline; diachronic and NA-pool results do not depend on the audit.

hypotheses.statement: V7: rare lexical title features ('using', R24, R26, LLM slot words, title typography) are unauditable (fewer than 10 v1-present titles in an arm).
hypotheses.estimate: using: v1-present 4 acc / 5 rej; R24: v1-present 6 acc / 3 rej; R26: v1-present 8 acc / 0 rej; slot_llm: v1-present 6 acc / 2 rej; title_typo: v1-present 0 acc / 0 rej
hypotheses.notes: The PLAN example ('using' in only 4 accepted v1 titles) is regenerated with the v2 detector.

hypotheses.statement: Differential findability: accepted papers are found on arXiv more often than rejected papers; reweighting usable pairs by 1/P(usable | year, decision, title length, NAME) leaves the NAME bound unchanged.
hypotheses.estimate: found 88.6% vs 56.3%; logit OR(accepted) 6.16 [4.02, 9.44], OR(NAME) 1.37 [0.86, 2.20]; usable pair OR(accepted) 2.76 [1.97, 3.86]; pre-decision v1 given found OR(accepted) 1.04 [0.67, 1.63]; IPW x population NAME DiD 2.01 pp [-3.71, 7.74]
hypotheses.notes: Findability differs by decision, not by NAME or title length; v1 timing given found does not differ.

hypotheses.statement: Camera-ready retitling: accepted papers' stored titles differ from the pre-decision arXiv v1 more often than rejected papers' (descriptive; no pre-registered threshold).
hypotheses.notes: Rejected papers retitle too (arXiv vs OpenReview wording, rebuttal edits); only the excess is camera-ready editing.

hypotheses.statement: Route validation (findability): a title-free route (first-author surname + distinctive abstract words) finds papers at a similar rate, so the accepted-rejected findability gap is not an artefact of title search.
hypotheses.estimate: partial n = 300 of 300 (acc 150, rej 150); found A/B: acc 0.887/0.847, rej 0.527/0.487; gap A 0.360, gap B 0.360, B - A -0.000 [-0.060, 0.060]; arXiv-id agreement when both found 0.995
hypotheses.notes: Paired on the same random subsample of the original audit; McNemar p per decision in route_validation.csv.

hypotheses.statement: Route validation (title stability): the title route does not select on title stability; retitling among route-B pairs matches route-A pairs, and adding papers only route B finds leaves the flip DiDs unchanged.
hypotheses.estimate: retitled v1 vs stored: route A 0.244 (n=160), route B 0.265 (n=155); B-only usable pairs 6 (4 retitled); latest arXiv title differs from stored: A 0.127, B 0.140
hypotheses.notes: Verdict rule (descriptive, set after the pilot design): supported if route-level retitling rates differ by < 5 pp and papers found only by route B are not retitled > 20 pp more often than route-A pairs; partially supported if only the first holds; not testable if fewer than 5 B-only pairs. See the union_route spec for the effect on the flip DiDs.

hypotheses.statement: Gate for D4-H4a: NAME neutrality (pooled 2024-26 G_total inside [0.90, 1.11]) survives camera-ready uncertainty (editing-corrected 90% CI combining universe bootstrap and audit).
hypotheses.estimate: G_total observed 1.021 90% CI [1.001, 1.041]; audit-implied [0.867, 1.081]; corrected 90% CI [0.885, 1.069]. G_dec: observed 1.050, corrected 90% CI [0.930, 1.089] (inside the margins)
hypotheses.notes: G_total is more sensitive to editing than G_dec because accepted papers are a smaller share of s0 (a0) than of s2 (a2). Enlarged-audit gate: 2024-26 pooled; enlarged audit, partial, n = 280/175 pairs: corrected 90% CI [0.921, 1.066], passes=True

hypotheses.statement: Gate for D4-H4b: depletion of title LLM markers (L-title G_total < 1, 2024-26) survives the audit.
hypotheses.estimate: G_total 0.980, 90% CI [0.938, 1.024]; audit-implied [0.755, 1.187]; corrected 90% CI [0.793, 1.164]; L-title auditable=False
hypotheses.notes: G_desk x G_exit uses submission-stage text and needs no audit (D4).

hypotheses.statement: Abstract audit (extension): the accepted/all depletion of arXiv-measurable abstract LLM markers (F24 or F26 words; G_total < 1, 2024-26) survives the camera-ready audit. Em dash and other typography are unauditable through arXiv (TeX dashes).
hypotheses.estimate: F24: DiD 3.55 pp [-1.62, 8.73], tip_total -0.67 pp, G_total 0.963, identified=False; F24_2: DiD 0.00 pp [-2.90, 2.90], tip_total -0.31 pp, G_total 0.894, identified=False; F26_words: DiD 0.33 pp [-3.53, 4.18], tip_total 0.78 pp, G_total 1.087, identified=False; abs_emdash: DiD -1.10 pp [-7.74, 5.53], tip_total -0.19 pp, G_total 0.979, identified=False; L_abstract: DiD 3.59 pp [-4.14, 11.31], tip_total -0.26 pp, G_total 0.993, identified=False; L_abs_words: DiD 3.88 pp [-1.61, 9.38], tip_total -0.06 pp, G_total 0.998, identified=False
hypotheses.notes: arXiv v1 abstract vs stored abstract; n = 206 acc / 124 rej.

hypotheses.statement: D4-H4c direction assumption: camera-ready polishing does not lower accepted papers' abstract LLM-marker (RARE21/F24) rates relative to rejected papers (net-flip DiD >= 0), so the accepted-only understatement of the Kobak bound is conservative.
hypotheses.estimate: F24 net flips: accepted 1.94 pp (8 adds / 4 drops, v1-present 20), rejected -1.61 pp (1 / 3, v1-present 13); DiD 3.55 pp [-1.62, 8.73]
hypotheses.notes: supported = CI above 0; partially = point >= 0, CI includes 0; not_supported = point < 0, CI includes 0; falsified = CI below 0. Pairs from all audit years (2022-26).
